quote: The death toll from a Russian strike on Kramatorsk has risen to 30 people, with another 18 injured
shows: The toll of 30 was public about 13 hours before the report that said 12. The ledger's own line, 'not an error at the time', is therefore wrong; see kramatorsk-ledger-1019.

quote: Iran is still reviewing a US response to its proposal regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and will reply to Washington via intermediaries when the review is over, foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei said on Monday.
shows: Iran's foreign ministry said the exchange was still open, the day after the report said Iran was no longer responding.

quote: UK Maritime Trade Operations ... has recorded four more previously-unreported attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz occurring Sunday. The news adds to the two strikes previously reported, bringing the total for October 11 to six attacks
shows: Six ships hit on 11 Oct, not two. Dated the same day as the report; the time zone of the page's timestamp is not stated, so whether it was knowable is left open.

quote: at least 600,000 people across Ukraine were left without electricity after deadly overnight Russian missile and drone strikes
shows: The night after the report a massive strike on energy followed; one quiet night was not reciprocity.
The official 14 Oct 10-year yield is 5.19, not 5.3. FRED published it after the report, but the market closed about two hours before it, so a close was there to read.

quote: Russia bears full responsibility for these developments
shows: Romania's foreign minister attributed the strikes to Russia about six hours before the report said Romania did not attribute them.
Rebuilding 16 Oct from lasting states only gives 66.3, not the published 67.5.

quote: The death toll from a Russian strike on Kramatorsk has risen to 30 people, with another 18 injured
shows: The same source as for kramatorsk-toll-1008: the earlier entry's 'not an error at the time' does not hold.
